notes.title: Update April 1
notes.content:
v.1.0.2.0


- Fixed an issue in which you get locked out of continuing the story once an error message appears in Chapter 5 in the main game.
- Fixed an issue in which you get locked out of continuing the story once an error message appears after completing Challege No. 24 and obtaining Griffin Lord in both the main game and the demo version.
- Fixed several inconsistencies in the name of the item, Large Light Feather, in the Traditional Chinese and the Simplified Chinese versions of the game.


- The image used at the end of the demo version has been updated.

We have also identified the bugs below.
- After using Peppermint's skill, Somebody Help Me!, the game freezes when you run away from battle before the effect of the skill is applied.
Should this happen, restarting the game will solve this issue.
- The game crashes when you fast forward the dialogues in Chapter 14.
Please avoid using the fast forward function in Chapter 14.

notes.title: Notice on the Update Ver. 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
There will be an update for PARTY RUSH!! at 8:00 p.m. March 31st (PDT).

- Several bugs that many people are experiencing will be fixed in both the main game and the demo version.
- The image used at the end of the demo version will be updated.

Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience that we have caused, and thank you for your continued support.
